item.title: A new HBO series riffs on DC Comics' 'Green Lantern'
item.description: With sharp dialogue and a strong cast, Lanterns is a mashup of superpower action, odd couple comedy, and old school cop story. It boasts the pleasures, and betrays the perils of pushing the comic book envelope.
item.content:encoded: With sharp dialogue and a strong cast, Lanterns is a mashup of superpower action, odd couple comedy, and old school cop story. It boasts the pleasures, and betrays the perils of pushing the comic book envelope.

item.title: What excites us? What scares us? Find out at 'Camp Miasma'
item.description: Hannah Einbinder and Gillian Anderson star in Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma, Jane Schoenbrun's satirical film about a young filmmaker who's rebooting a fictional slasher franchise.

item.title: 'The End of Oak Street' is a good time at the movies, plain and simple
item.description: Writer-director David Robert Mitchell knows what he's doing: this movie is silly, scary, and over-the-top all at once.

item.title: How would a Kennedy Center shutdown impact artists and audiences?
item.description: The Kennedy Center's profile has already shifted. If the shutdown is approved by a federal judge, its primary stages will not reopen until at least 2028 and audiences may decline further.

item.title: World's youngest museum curator, 11, was led by a love of fossils
item.description: NPR's Ailsa Chang speaks with Anderson Taylor, who has become the Guinness World Record holder for youngest male museum curator. He opened a natural history museum at age 9.

item.title: Kennedy Center Board votes again to shut main building down — and add Trump's name back
item.description: The board voted to close the Washington, D.C., arts complex's main campus for a $250 million renovation — three months after a federal judge temporarily blocked a similar closure.

item.title: 'I'm a say yes person': Actor Colman Domingo is up for new challenges
item.description: Domingo is nominated for two Emmy Awards for two very different performances — in the Netflix comedy The Four Seasons and in HBO's Euphoria. "I can go very deep with my characters," he says.

item.title: She isn't just sewing a dress. She's growing one
item.description: In an age of fast fashion, author Eve Schaub wanted to go back to basics by growing a dress in her backyard. She's been working on her linen dress for over a year and still has a ways to go.

item.title: Comedian Jeff Arcuri talks about the art of crowd work
item.description: NPR's A Martinez talks with comedian Jeff Arcuri about the stand-up comic art of crowd work, which involves talking to audience members and ad-libbing off what they say.
